style: Use a polite, neutral register without ครับ/ค่ะ, and address the user as คุณ only when a pronoun is needed. Thai has no letter case; Latin names and abbreviations keep their own case (SAR, AI, 3D). A command that opens a dialog keeps the trailing … directly after the text. Thai sentences take no full stop; separate clauses and sentences with a single space, and use Arabic digits, not Thai digits. Menu paths are written ไฟล์ ▸ เปิด with a space either side of ▸. Key names (Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Esc, F1) stay as they are.
